List any details of the original omitted, added, or changed in EACH version: task, entity, numbers, persona, hobbies, research interests, constraints, certainty, options, scope. Even secondary persona omissions count as NOT equivalent. Do NOT approve merely because the main idea survived. Are A and B directly equivalent to one another? Do not favor formality. Return JSON {"a_preserves_all":true/false,"b_preserves_all":true/false,"pair_equivalent":true/false,"differences":"brief concrete omissions/additions"}.
